description: This file defines an abstract base class for analyzing the end of a user's turn in audio conversations, including state enumeration, parameters, and core analysis methods.

classes.name: EndOfTurnState
classes.description: Enumeration representing whether the user has completed their turn or is still speaking.

classes.name: BaseTurnParams
classes.description: Base class for turn analyzer parameters.

classes.name: BaseTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: Abstract base class for analyzing user end of turn, including methods for appending audio, analyzing end of turn, and managing sample rate.

methods.name: set_sample_rate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for audio processing, either using the initial sample rate if provided or the given value.

methods.name: speech_triggered
methods.description: Abstract property to determine if speech has been detected.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Abstract property to get current turn analyzer parameters.

methods.name: append_audio
methods.description: Abstract method to append audio data for analysis, returning the end of turn state.

methods.name: analyze_end_of_turn
methods.description: Abstract asynchronous method to analyze if an end of turn has occurred.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Abstract method to reset the turn analyzer to its initial state.
